question:
Choose the correct option to give a one-word substitution for the sentence given:

Killing of an unborn baby.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Foeticide**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Foeticide"** refers to the act of killing an unborn baby or fetus. (भ्रूण हत्या)
 
 
• **Example: **The government has strict laws against foeticide to prevent illegal abortions.
 
 
• The word **"Foeticide"** is specific to the termination of a fetus and is used in medical and legal contexts. (भ्रूण हत्या)
 
 
• **Example: **Foeticide is a serious crime in many countries and is punishable under law.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Foeticide**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Homicide **(हत्या): The deliberate and unlawful killing of one person by another.
 
 
• **Example: **The detective investigated the case of homicide that occurred last night.
 
 
 
• **Paternity **(पितृत्व): The state or quality of being a father.
 
 
• **Example: **A DNA test was conducted to establish paternity in the legal dispute.
 
 
 
• **Maternity **(मातृत्व): The state or quality of being a mother.
 
 
• **Example: **She is on maternity leave after giving birth to her baby.
